messages:
kevin: Heads-up — planning a geo rollout tonight at 23:00 UTC. Sequence: US -> EU -> APAC. Change window ~3h. Proposing we pin version r-infer@v2.3.1 across regions. Any blocking concerns?

sophie: @kevin ACK. Running capacity checks now, ETA ~15m. Ops leaning toward a 100QPS warm-up per zone before canary.

raj: For EU let's start smaller — 5% canary (traffic/profile reasons). Also recommend disabling cross-region fallback for the first 30m to avoid noisy traffic migration.

ops-oncall: Capacity check results: US pool healthy (ready=24/25), EU shows CPU headroom tight — recommend +2 instances to meet p95 SLA. APAC quota is hitting account limits, opened INC-2457 to request quota bump.

kevin: OK, will provision +2 EU instances and follow INC-2457 for APAC. Rollback triggers we will enforce: error_rate >= 4% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency >= 1s sustained for 5m. SRE, can you wire those into the rollout alert policy?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout r-infer@v2.3.1 -> production at 2026-03-20T23:00:00Z. Plan: canary US 5% -> auto-promote to 25% after 10m if no triggers. Command: `/deploy release r-infer@v2.3.1 --regions us,eu,apac --sequence us,eu,apac --canary 5 --promote 10m`

ops-oncall: Added the alerting rules and temporary silence windows for non-actionable noisey alerts. Also pinned EU region to hold at 5% canary for 20m before any increase.

sophie: :thumbsup: I'll run a smoke load test at 22:45 UTC (approx 10k tokens/min) and post metrics.

raj: Note: if EU shows memory pressure we have an automated fallback to the quantized variant (r-infer@v2.3.1-q4). That fallback should be listed as a Tier-2 safety policy in the deploy plan.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Preflight complete. Smoke results attached by sophie. US smoke: p50 60ms, p95 210ms. EU smoke partial: p95 420ms, CPU 78% (trigger threshold 80%). APAC smoke deferred until quota resolved.

ops-oncall: Increased EU warm pool by 2 instances; monitoring for 30m. Will post any anomalies to this thread.

kevin: Locking the plan. Final go/no-go update from me at 22:55 UTC. If green, we'll publish release notes to #release-notes and notify Dedicated customers. Thanks everyone.
